headline: Cost of living protests surge across Europe
standfirst: Activists are organizing new demonstrations in Germany and France this weekend.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: Protests over living costs are hitting Germany and reigniting across France this Saturday.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: Activists say public services like housing and education are failing, fueling widespread anger.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: These demonstrations highlight growing public frustration with economic and social conditions.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Police are on high alert for potential looting or rioting on the fringes of these events.

caption:
New cost of living protests are planned for Germany and France this weekend.

Activists are organizing these demonstrations to voice concerns over the state of public services. Authorities are preparing for potential unrest on the fringes of the marches.
